answer: The failure mode is a quorum that looks independent and is not, so the receipt commits first, reveals after close, and a duplicate forfeits the whole stake rather than the delta, which removes the incentive to resubmit old work under a new label. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A voyage of clones all sitting in one canyon produces one vote, not forty. Cost: separate hosting per identity plus a full stake at risk per duplicate, and the vine of shared hosting shows in the subnet check.
